product_family: Wondershare Virbo, an AI video generation and avatar creation platform with 350+ AI avatars, 400+ voice options, AI voice cloning, talking photos, and video translation across 80+ languages. The product was officially discontinued on June 30, 2025; existing paid users can still access the service, but no new customers are accepted.

privacy.ai_training_note: The Wondershare Virbo EULA states: 'Raw Materials you provide must contain the Model's portrait, voice, and other personal information...Wondershare will provide AI avatar image customization and voice cloning services by processing and training Raw Materials,' and 'we may transmit your personal information to third-party algorithm technology service provider...for algorithm training.' Users accept that raw audio, video, and photos provided for voice cloning and avatar customization will be processed via algorithm technology and may be shared with third-party algorithm providers for training purposes.
privacy.data_region: International transfer to China and US; Virbo terms state: 'personal information...will be transferred to countries outside your country of residence (such as China, the United States)'

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Advanced encryption mechanisms mentioned in marketing (homepage states 'employ advanced encryption mechanisms and secure cloud storage') but no specific protocols detailed in privacy policy or technical documentation

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Personal data retained for duration of contractual relationship or legal obligations, then deleted per applicable legislation. Customized avatars/voices deleted upon subscription expiration.

security.name: Intellectual Property & Data Ownership
security.value: Wondershare retains all copyright and intellectual property rights of customized AI avatars and cloned voices. Users receive only limited usage rights during subscription period.

security.name: Third-Party Providers
security.value: Raw materials (voice recordings, photos, video footage) may be transmitted to third-party algorithm technology providers for algorithm training and avatar/voice customization.

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Custom avatars created are accessible only to the account holder; not visible to other users or the public unless explicitly shared.

products.name: Virbo for Web
products.data_scope: User-provided raw materials: audio recordings, video footage, images, scripts. Voice cloning requires 50-90 seconds of audio (up to 5GB). Avatar customization requires portrait/voice data.
products.notes: Web-based editor; accepts text, images, audio for video generation. Includes AI avatar selection (350+ avatars), voice selection (400+ voices), talking photo animation, video translation (150+ languages), script generation.

products.name: Virbo for Mobile
products.data_scope: Same as web version; mobile app for iOS and Android
products.notes: Cross-platform compatibility; same features as web but optimized for mobile devices.

products.name: Virbo Live
products.data_scope: Real-time streaming and live shopping with AI avatars
products.notes: Enterprise/business feature for live commerce and streaming

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid tiers; subscription-based access. Platform discontinued as of June 30, 2025, though existing paid users retain access.
compare.data_residency: International; explicitly transferred to China and US; unclear which regions house data centers

flags: Product discontinued June 30, 2025. Wondershare Virbo is no longer accepting new customers; only existing paid users can access it.

The terms of service state that customer-provided raw materials (voice, video, photos) are processed via 'algorithm training' and may be shared with third-party algorithm providers; this is a requirement of the service, not an opt-out choice.
Virbo transfers personal data internationally to China and the United States; buyers with data-residency requirements should confirm this before use.
Wondershare retains all intellectual property rights to customized avatars and cloned voices; users own neither the avatar nor the voice model, during the subscription or after it expires.

A third-party profile (Nudge Security) lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR for Wondershare, but none of these are documented on Virbo's own pages or Wondershare's trust center; they may apply to the parent company or other products rather than Virbo. No SOC 2 Type II report, HIPAA BAA or attestation, or ISO 27001 certificate was found for Virbo specifically.

The privacy policy lacks detail on encryption protocols, key management, or specific security standards; marketing materials claim 'advanced encryption' and 'secure cloud storage' but provide no specifics.

The Nudge Security profile lists certifications for 'Wondershare.com' broadly; it is unclear whether these apply to Virbo specifically or to the parent company/other products (PDFelement, Signx, etc.). No Virbo-specific trust center exists.
The privacy policy makes no mention of a Data Processing Agreement or GDPR Article 28 compliance for B2B use; only standard terms of service are published.

Virbo requires users to confirm they have permission to use the voices and likenesses being cloned, and to provide written consent for third-party likenesses; the consent language may not meet jurisdictional requirements for deepfake-adjacent use.
